name: 85043 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85043 (Phoenix) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85043 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85043 (Phoenix) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
